_notes: Hand-curated availability matrix (programme-tracker P1.4). One row per (ministry, indicator-need). availability vocabulary: available (a BPS/official series exists AND is acquired in THIS repo, series_ref points at the real file), partial (exists at the provider or only a proxy exists, not acquired — say which in notes), not-collected (no official series; a probe finding, not a gap to fake). Render rule (data-model.md): a row renders only with a real _source_url AND _verified_at; rows carrying TODO-VERIFY anywhere are skipped by the loader. IMPORTANT P1 scope limit: rows are included ONLY where a series physically exists in the repo TODAY (verified by reading the file) — needs whose BPS variables were not probed in this session are left OUT entirely rather than padded with a guessed verdict. The P1.1 probe (bps-webapi model/var + model/th) is the next session's work and will add the partial/not-collected rows.
